WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Stakeholder Translation & Technical Spec Design: Partner closely with business stakeholders to extract core needs and translate them into rigorous technical specifications for AI systems and agent behaviors.

Perform Advanced Data Manipulation: Use SQL, Python to extract and profile data from structured and unstructured sources, ensuring high-quality data inputs for both machine learning models and LLM agent contexts.

Full-Stack Logic Integration: Apply a "full-stack" mindset to AI development. You will use GitHub Workflows, GitHub CoPilot and AWS Bedrock to ensure a seamless flow of data between the backend, AI agents, and the UI, while ensuring your code is architected for automated CI/CD pipelines and stable production environments.

Build & Orchestrate AI Agents: Develop and refine autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph to power intelligent chatbots, designing stateful, multi-step workflows that navigate complex business logic.

Design AI Systems: Design AI solutions with a "production-first" logic. While others may handle the final deployment, you are responsible for ensuring your Python-based agents are modular, and secure, leverage AWS Cloud platform.

Build for Observability: Develop evaluation frameworks and metrics to monitor the accuracy, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of AI agents and traditional statistical models.

R&D:Develop, experiment with, and refine autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, conducting iterative research and prototyping to evaluate new agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, and stateful workflows before scaling them into production-grade systems.

Security: Maintain and enhance package and dependency management tools such as poetry and npm to comply with corporate development standards and resolve Critical Vulnerabilities identified by automated code quality scanning tools.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

The DS Core: A Graduate degree in an analytical field (Math, Stats, CS, BI etc.) and 2+ years of experience in an analytically driven role.

Agentic Expertise: 2+ years of experience specifically building AI agents and designing complex systems that leverage LangGraph or similar orchestration frameworks.

Full-Stack Awareness: A strong understanding of the full-stack lifecycle, including how data travels from backend databases through the application logic to a conversational UI.

Language Proficiency: Strong command of Python and SQL (required).

AWS Cloud Fluency: Hands-on experience building applications within the AWS LLM ecosystem (Bedrock, SageMaker) and a functional understanding of working within an AWS Lambda environment.

Statistical Rigor: A strong background in machine learning and statistical analysis, with the ability to validate agent outputs against business benchmarks.

Production Perspective: Experience designing solutions with a "production-grade" mindset—understanding the requirements for reliability, security, and scalability.

PREFERRED:

Experience with AWS Bedrock Agents and action group integration.

Demonstrated ability to navigate under-defined problems and deliver robust solutions in fast-moving environments.

Working knowledge of generative AI orchestration frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and enterprise AI deployment pipelines.

We value diverse experiences, skills, and a passion for innovation. If your background aligns with this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, please email careers@mutualofomaha.com. Please allow at least one week after applying before requesting a status update.

Here, your skills spark progress. You’ll solve meaningful problems, collaborate with passionate teammates, and grow in a space where innovation is the norm—not the exception.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at careers@mutualofomaha.com. Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. As the partner of choice for inspiring bakery success, we help customers grow their business through meaningful partnerships, research-driven insights and innovations, and products and expertise they can depend on. As a family-owned company, our commitments to our people, products, customers, and corporate values, are all part of our recipe for success.

_

Why work for Dawn Foods?

PEOPLE. PRODUCTS. CUSTOMERS.

Why should you apply? We invest in you!

  • Industry-leading health insurance on Day 1!
  • Competitive Pay
  • 401(K) + company match
  • 10 Paid Company Holidays
  • Paid Time Off
  • Professional training
  • Family-owned business over 100 years in service
  • An opportunity for career advancement, working as part of an empowering workforce

Job Purpose and Overview

The Regional Controller is a key business partner to the Regional Distribution Centers in the United States and Canada and the Supply Chain COE supporting North America. This role leads financial understanding and stewardship across the NA supply chain. The person in this role provides financial analysis, guidance, and insights on effective and efficient Supply Chain execution. The ideal candidate will have experience in financial modeling and forecasting, cost analysis, cost-saving opportunity identification, as well as expert communication skills to audiences at all levels of the organization.

Work Environment & Travel: This is a remote position with up to 20% travel. Candidates must reside in the Eastern or Central time zones to be considered.

What will you do as a Regional Controller – NA Supply Chain at Dawn Foods?

  • Lead financial KPI analytics and business partnering with Supply Chain and Commercial Finance to drive insights and actions improving cost, working capital, pricing support, and supply chain execution across NA.
  • Lead and support the development of business policies and performance measures, leveraging technology to enhance visibility, standardization, and decision-making.
  • Forecast, analyze, and Report North American warehousing and transportation costs by distribution center.
  • Champion financial considerations in Supply Chain Network Design by building models to evaluate scenarios under consideration, including distribution center location, network capabilities, and equipment make versus buy.
  • Lead financial tracking and analysis of Route Optimization project.
  • Develop and report metrics to track efficiency and improvement opportunities related to distribution center performance.
  • Routinely analyze data, investigate issues, variances, and trends, identify solutions, and recommend actions based on business analytics to guide key business decisions.
  • Promote clear understanding of the financial impact of operational issues and opportunities.
  • Design, implement, and administer financial systems and procedures.
  • Responsible for all aspects of difficult projects that are broad in nature and require originality and/or ingenuity.
  • Perform a variety of necessary tasks for all assignments, including preparing work plan and schedule, completing detailed analysis and research, identifying options, preparing reports for management, and recommending action or change based on findings.
  • Assist in the development of business policies and performance measures.
  • Conduct special financial and business-related studies as requested by management.
  • Work collaboratively across company functions and the entire finance team
  • Provide back-up support for other Finance positions as required.
  • Perform analyses that are complex and varied in nature.
  • Duties require significant evaluation, originality, and ingenuity.
  • Provide coaching and guidance for Financial Analysts as needed.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned or requested.
  • Demonstrate the “Dawn Values” of Team Dawn and support the Circle of Excellence.

What Does It Take to be a Regional Controller – NA Supply at Dawn Foods? 

Below are the minimum qualifications to be a fit for this job.  

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related discipline is required.
    • Master’s degree in finance or a similar focus is strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant financial experience as a Finance Business Partner.

Vasion is looking for a Staff Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical authority behind every deal — guiding prospects from program offices and IT leads to agency executives, shaping deal strategy, and winning the technical decision with confidence. We modernize how federal agencies handle documents, print, and content workflows across classified and unclassified environments, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform — and we're looking for the person who can bring that story to life in every solution we design.

At a glance

  • Segment: Enterprise and Commercial
  • Vertical focus: Federal
  • Location: DC Metro / Northern Virginia
  • Work model: Remote; Ability to travel up to 25%
  • Sales motion: Technical consultative selling across net-new and expansion
  • Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance strongly preferred

What success looks like

You win the technical decision in complex, high-value federal evaluations, navigate procurement cycles with confidence, and set customers up for clean implementations and lasting expansion. Handoffs are tight, risks are caught early, and every engagement reflects the precision the mission demands. Beyond the deal, you establish yourself as a technical thought leader whose influence shapes the team, the organization, and the industry.

Where You'll Have Impact

Ownership of technical strategy across high-impact solution domains, driving systemic wins, scaling enablement, and converting field intelligence into product and practice improvements:

  • Discovery and value mapping: Lead technical discovery across technical and business stakeholders, surfacing objectives, constraints, and success criteria to drive strategic account planning, identifying must-win accounts and adapting strategy as conditions shift.
  • Demonstrations and POCs: Build and deliver tailored demos and sandbox environments that connect product capabilities to prospect problems, with clear success criteria, exit gates, and multi-stakeholder coordination ****across complex federal scenarios.
  • Technical leadership in the deal: Recommend reference architectures across general IT, classified, and IL4 to IL6 environments, addressing security, compliance, performance, and scalability concerns while resolving technical objections and partnering with Services on SOW inputs. Provide technical foresight to identify and mitigate potential blockers in the POC. Contribute to the internal technical standards that scale across the business.
  • Competitive positioning and enablement: Articulate Vasion's differentiators versus alternatives and provide AEs, partners, and the broader SE team with reusable assets, competitive positioning, and technical selling skills.
  • Mentorship and enablement: Mentor and develop team members on competitive positioning, discovery, and demo craft. Raise the technical bar across the team.
  • Field feedback and readiness: Surface field insights that sharpen Product, Engineering, Marketing, Services, and CS and feed Sales and partners with reusable assets, expansion opportunities, and strategic partnerships.

What You Bring

Solution-wide mastery, domain expertise, cross-functional influence, and the ability to convert field intelligence into ecosystem-wide impact:

  • Presales and Communication: Discovery, objection handling, storytelling, demonstrations, and executive communication with the ability to navigate federal procurement cycles and ATO-driven evaluation timelines with confidence.
  • Architecture and Systems Thinking: Foundational understanding of common enterprise software architecture patterns (C4 Model) and cloud infrastructure (Docker, Azure, AWS). Ability to apply software patterns (MSA, EDA) and diagram types (DFDs, sequence) to RMF documentation, system boundary definitions, and classified enclave reviews.
  • Networking and Identity: Troubleshooting DNS, proxies, firewalls, VPCs, and NLBs within NIPR/SIPR and DoD network enclaves; strong grasp of LDAP, CAC/PKI, Azure Entra, Okta, and Ping in DoD identity environments; familiarity with NFS in secure storage contexts.
  • Security and Compliance: PKI basics, network security standards, and deep familiarity with FedRAMP High, RMF, DISA STIGs, CUI protection, SOC 2, and ISO as they apply to print and output management deployments.
  • Domain Expertise: Print, Workflow, and Output Automation across IL4–IL6 cloud stacks (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP) and on-premises DoD environments.
  • Technical Toolbox: Diagramming (RMF/ATO packages); bash and/or PowerShell; SQL basics; RESTful APIs; CI/CD fundamentals with DevSecOps knowledge.

Requirements

Solution-wide technical mastery, deep presales acumen, and the cross-functional influence that drives systemic impact beyond the deal:

  • 7+ years in presales Solutions Engineering for SaaS or enterprise software, with significant DoD or federal account experience.
  • Proven track record running successful POCs and technical evaluations in complex, strategic accounts, classified or restricted federal environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field or equivalent experience.
  • English language proficiency; additional language skills valued for allied-nation and coalition engagements.

What Sets You Apart

Domain expertise and field intelligence that eliminates friction, scales impact, and accelerates ecosystem-wide growth from day one:

  • Active TS/SCI eligibility or existing SCI access.
  • Proven experience navigating complex federal integrations and SI-led delivery partnerships (Leidos, SAIC, Booz Allen, Peraton).
  • Working knowledge of CMMC, JSIG, or IC-specific compliance frameworks.
  • Exceptional written and presentation skills tailored to federal audiences and evaluation processes.

Benefits

  • Flexible work environment
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive pay
  • A full suite of traditional benefits
  • Training/Advancement opportunities
  • 401k with company match and immediate vesting
  • Financial wellness education
  • Company-contributed HSA
  • Onsite perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.

Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

  • Disruptive Visionaries — We think boldly and author missions that challenge the status quo. We don't follow the path; we help create it.
  • Relationship Builders — We treat people as people. We build strong, lasting relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication with teammates, customers, and partners alike.
  • Candor Seekers — We believe candid conversations are how great things get done. We care enough to challenge directly and create space for others to do the same.
  • Action Owners — We take ownership of wins, failures, and outcomes. No matter your role or tenure, you have the power and the responsibility to drive results.

More about Vasion

Visit https://www.vasion.com to learn more about Vasion.

raw.description:
About aion

Aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.

We work differently than most AI companies: our teams deploy alongside our customers, turning production-ready AI into real business outcomes in weeks, not quarters.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale.

Who You Are

You're a customer-focused AI consultant and software engineer who enjoys solving complex business problems using cutting-edge AI technologies. You have experience working directly with enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges, and designing scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You combine strong technical expertise with exceptional consulting skills. You're comfortable translating business requirements into solution architectures, collaborating with engineering teams to deliver production-ready AI applications, and guiding customers through every stage of their AI transformation journey.

You're product-minded and understand that successful AI adoption is about more than technology. It requires strategic thinking, customer empathy, technical leadership, and the ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives.

You thrive in customer-facing environments, enjoy working across multiple industries, and are excited to help organizations unlock the full potential of enterprise AI.

What You'll Do

Customer Discovery & AI Consulting

  • Partner with enterprise customers to understand their business challenges, workflows, and AI transformation goals.
  • Conduct discovery workshops, technical assessments, and solution design sessions to identify high-impact AI opportunities.
  • Advise customers on AI strategy, implementation roadmaps, and best practices for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions aligned with customer objectives.

Solution Architecture

  • Design end-to-end AI solution architectures using Aion's enterprise AI platform.
  • Create scalable, secure, and production-ready architectures for AI applications, intelligent agents, automation workflows, and enterprise integrations.
  • Define technical solution blueprints covering infrastructure, data flows, APIs, security, and deployment strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to ensure successful implementation of customer solutions.

Implementation & Delivery

  • Lead technical solution delivery from proof of concept through production deployment.
  • Work alongside customers during implementation, ensuring successful integration with existing enterprise systems.
  • Support solution validation, performance optimization, testing, and production readiness.
  • Resolve technical challenges and recommend architecture improvements throughout project execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, AI, Customer Success, and Sales teams to continuously improve Aion's platform and customer experience.
  • Provide customer feedback that influences product roadmap and platform capabilities.
  • Support technical demonstrations, solution workshops, RFP responses, and executive presentations.
  • Develop reusable architecture patterns, reference implementations, and best practices for enterprise AI deployments.

Thought Leadership

  • Stay current with advancements in AI, Large Language Models, agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software.
  • Represent Aion at customer meetings, industry events, and technical workshops.
  • Contribute to solution playbooks, architecture documentation, and technical enablement materials.
  • Help establish Aion as a trusted advisor in enterprise AI transformation.

Requirements

Technical Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, Enterprise Architecture, or Software Engineering.
  • Experience designing and delivering enterprise software, cloud, or AI solutions for customers.
  • Strong understanding of Large Language Models, Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI architectures.
  • Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise solutions.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, cloud-native technologies, and modern application architectures.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, sales, and customer success.
  • Strong presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Bonus/ Good to Have

  • Enterprise AI: Experience implementing enterprise AI platforms, intelligent automation, AI copilots, multi-agent systems, or AI workflow orchestration.
  • Industry Consulting: Experience working with customers across financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, public sector, or other enterprise industries.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud architecture, Infrastructure-as-Code, DevOps, MLOps, or enterprise platform engineering.
  • Pre-sales & Customer Success: Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles, solution demonstrations, technical workshops, or proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Enterprise Integrations: Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, CRMs, ERPs, productivity suites, and business systems.

Benefits

Preferred Attributes:

  • Founder-level ownership and bias for action.
  • Strong strategic thinking and ability to connect technical decisions to business impact.
  • Excellent communication and mentoring skills.
  • Thrives in ambiguity, fast-paced environments, and early-stage startup culture.

Why Join aion?

  • Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy.
  • Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally.
  • Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions.
  • Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits

COMPENSATION DETAILS

raw.description:
About the role

The Application Administrator position will work with customers to help them get the most out of their Atlassian software, including configuring and customizing key Atlassian Software applications (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Desk), as well as other Atlassian applications and marketplace software. As part of our clients' partially outsourced teams, this position will assist their businesses by acting as a remote administrator on a day-to-day basis.

This position will work with customers to respond to requests on a priority basis in a timely fashion to configure their Atlassian software to meet their needs. The role will also directly help customers automate processes to improve efficiencies and streamline processes. The Application Administrator will perform as a remote outsourced Atlassian administrator for various clients at the same time.

What you'll be doing

  • Maintaining high proficiency in Atlassian and Adaptavist toolsets, contributing to team knowledge sharing and adhering to best practices
  • Onboard and become familiar with customer applications
  • Monitoring and responding to customer requests on the Adaptavist service desk
  • Answering customer questions about how to best use the Atlassian applications in their business
  • Creating projects, configuring permissions and workflows and other solutions at the request of the customer
  • Working on multiple administrative activities according to agreed upon customer priorities
  • Communicating with the customer and other team members to understand and deliver configuration solutions
  • Solving issues and providing best practice recommendations to the customer
  • Recording your work and time
  • Following security protocols that the customer may establish

What we're looking for

  • Experience administering the Atlassian toolset, in particular, Jira and Confluence
  • Ability to demonstrate experience in consulting and user support
  • Experience customizing Atlassian software through the use of workflows and add-ons, for example ScriptRunner
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a virtual face-to-face environment through online tools (e.g. WebEx, Zoom, Slack, Skype, etc.)
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills
  • An ability to think innovatively and creatively
  • Personable, helpful and professional attitude

A few nice-to-haves

  • Knowledge of the build process – Continuous Integration and Delivery
  • Experience in using GitLab or Sonatype software
  • Knowledge of Groovy or other programming language
  • Experience in creating technical documentation and sharing knowledge

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Adaptavist, part of The Adaptavist Group, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet.

Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

Annual Base Salary: $85,000-102,500 USD

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

What to expect

We have published some support on Interviewing with us to try to alleviate any pre-interview anxieties, here you’ll find information to help you prepare and ace an interview at TAG.

You can read them here

Equal opportunities for everyone

At The Adaptavist Group, we are committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community and believe this positively impacts both the creation of our innovative products and our delivery of bespoke solutions to our global customers and our own unique culture. We encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, disability, race, sexual orientation, religion or belief, sex, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, marriage, and civil partnership status.

Recruitment fraud notice

We are aware of recruitment scams where individuals or organisations may falsely claim to represent us. We take this seriously and are committed to protecting candidates throughout our hiring process.

We will never ask for any form of payment, fees, or financial commitment at any stage of recruitment, including applications, interviews, onboarding, or equipment provision.

Most of our recruitment communications are sent from our system, SmartRecruiters, and may come from addresses such as @smartrecruiters.com. All our emails are signed off by The Talent Team @ The Adaptavist Group.

If you are ever unsure about the authenticity of a message or job offer, please verify it via our official careers channels before responding.

Working at The Adaptavist Group

The Adaptavist Group is a global family of companies with a common goal. We combine the best of teamwork, technology, and processes, helping all kinds of businesses be better today and tomorrow.

We are experts at delivering enterprise software, tailored solutions, and quality services across some of the world’s most trusted technology ecosystems, including Atlassian, AWS, Slack, GitLab, monday.com and Aha!

We make change happen. From anywhere.

What we offer you

We offer a very generous holiday (PTO) allowance, trusting you to take vacation time that suits your personal life, alongside flexible working hours that empower you to work when it best fits you and your team. We provide MacBooks to all employees and additional support for fully remote workers to set up their home offices.

Our exceptional Time Away Policy includes 26 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents, 13 weeks for non-birthing parents, and extended leave for adoption, IVF, surrogacy, elective egg freezing, and women's health needs such as menopause, menstruation, endometriosis, and PCOS.

Our trusting, flexible, remote-first way of working means that work can fit around your life, rather than your life fitting around work.

Read our full list of benefits

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to join our growing, fully-remote team, helping people get incredible video with Camo.

Camo’s customers include individuals and teams around the world who use video to meet, present, create or stream. We’re one of Europe’s 200 fastest growing companies according to the FT, and Camo’s one of the most popular and highly-rated apps on PC, Mac and mobile. Camo’s technology powers the latest & greatest computers, accessories and chips from partners including Razer, HP, Elgato, AMD, Intel, Qualcomm and NVIDIA.

This role is part of the management team and will involve close work with the CEO and founder. We recently split marketing from partnerships & BD, giving latitude to grow the capabilities of the marketing function, taking full ownership of budget, resources, and outcomes. We’re expecting the right candidate to be based in the UK or Europe; while the company is remote, the role will require occasional travel to our London HQ.

Here’s Aidan, Reincubate’s founder, talking about the role.

You will:

  • Own marketing across the full funnel and lifecycle, leveraging your own skills alongside those of a small team and external partners to get results across inbound, conversion & retention
  • Define strategy and execute for organic & paid channels; currently, we have most success with content & SEO, creator partnerships, community, events, social, product marketing, email & PPC
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to influence onboarding, activation, and upgrade moments
  • Know what good looks like; you’ll define and execute against marketing metrics, consistently measuring, reporting, and achieving set goals
  • Use AI and automation actively to move faster and do more

We will:

  • Help you set up and contribute to a productive working environment, wherever you are: delight builds on delight
  • Give you autonomy in your work, we trust you to solve hard problems well
  • Help you settle into your role, manage your responsibilities, and grow as a member of the team: progress comes through sustainable growth
  • Provide a space for you to share your opinions and ideas on any topic; integrity and openness are bedrocks of how we interact with one another and our users
  • Provide excellent benefits: 25 days’ paid vacation, flexible hours, remote work, healthcare, matched pension contribution, home-office, wellness and professional development allowances

You might suit this role if you have:

  • Passion for hands-on execution as part of a small team, paired with the ability to lead
  • 4+ years in growth marketing and demonstrable results to showcase, ideally in a media, lifestyle or creator-oriented field
  • Deep familiarity with self-serve and product-led growth funnels
  • Experience using AI effectively to build & automate, and are actively tinkering with emergent AI tools & techniques for growth and marketing productivity
  • Strong systems thinking: you can build from scratch and design processes that scale and which are data-driven
  • Good judgement and taste: you can prioritise independently and know when something isn’t working and figure out a way to fix it, and have good eye for detail & quality
  • Alignment with our values: creating delight, “it just works”, sustainability, and integrity

You’ll maximise your chances when applying if you:

  • Include a CV that gives us a great idea of who you are and what you’re about
  • Take a little time to look at who we are, and what we’re looking for (see camo.com/about)
  • Share evidence of the sort of things we’re looking for in your cover letter
  • We recommend not using AI to write your application; this often results in similar-looking applications that make it harder to learn about you

We’re a small team and we don’t have the capacity to respond directly to every single application. Believe me, we don’t feel great about that so we want to be upfront about it. We know the hiring process can be tough and we really appreciate everyone who takes the time to apply

raw.description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.
We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

We're looking for a Solution Owner (Data, Technology & AI) to be the face of CompassX on a complex, high-visibility client engagement. This isn't a traditional Project Manager role. We need someone who sits with client executives from the earliest conversations - while a solution is still just a problem statement - and stays with it through design, build, and adoption. You'll be trusted to shape what gets built, not just track when it ships.

The strongest candidates bring a rare combination: consulting-grade client presence and leadership, real solution design and architecture instincts, and enough technical fluency in data and AI to know when an approach is right - not just when a sprint is on schedule.

While we have a strong preference for candidates local to the Southern California (LA/OC) area, exceptional candidates based elsewhere within the United States will also be considered.

What You'll Do

    Client Leadership & Communication

  • Act as the primary, trusted face of CompassX to senior client stakeholders - building the kind of credibility that gets you invited into the room before a problem is even fully defined

  • Lead executive-level conversations that turn ambiguous business challenges into a clear, actionable solution direction

  • Build consensus across stakeholder groups with competing priorities, and know how to navigate organizational dynamics without losing momentum

    • Solution Design & Ownership

  • Own the design of the solution itself - not just the plan to deliver it. Shape the approach, validate it technically, and defend it under scrutiny

  • Partner closely with architects, engineers, and data/AI practitioners to ensure the technical approach holds up, while remaining the accountable owner of the overall solution

  • Drive process improvement and "ways of working" recommendations as part of the solution, not as an afterthought

    • Data, Technology & AI Fluency

  • Evaluate the feasibility of data and AI use cases, and speak credibly to data pipelines, model approaches, and modern architecture

  • Bring a point of view on where AI genuinely adds value to a solution - and where it doesn't

  • Use AI as part of your own working style (research, synthesis, solutioning), modeling the kind of modern practice CompassX brings to clients

    • Delivery (supporting, not core)

  • Bring enough fluency in delivery fundamentals - Agile, UAT, data validation - to keep a workstream credible, with support from delivery specialists as needed

  • This is not a scrum-master or backlog-management role; delivery mechanics are a "nice to have," not the job

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience spanning consulting, product ownership, and/or solution design — ideally with time at a reputable consulting firm

  • A track record of being the trusted senior presence in front of executive clients, not just a coordinator of workstreams

  • Real experience shaping or designing a solution (architecture, process, or product), not only managing its delivery

  • Working knowledge of data and AI environments — pipelines, analytics, model evaluation, or modern data architecture

  • Strong executive communication and consensus-building skills

  • Bachelor's degree or higher (Business, Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent demonstrable experience

  • Ideally based in Southern California

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.
With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.
At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

Senior Business Process Consultant – Telecom

Remote – US/Canada, West

At NewRocket, we bring 20 years of experience advising and supporting clients in designing, implementing, and managing AI-enabled digital workflows that improve employee and customer experiences. As an Elite ServiceNow Partner and ServiceNow Global Partner Award Winner, we’ve completed more than 3,000 projects across nine industry specializations.

NewRocket Goes Beyond Workflows™ to help clients transform their enterprise into a place where employees flourish, customers thrive, and people matter. With more than 3,000 ServiceNow certifications, our teams take a strategic, business-led approach to solving complex industry challenges and delivering measurable outcomes.

NewRocket has been awarded the 2024 BEST Award, 2024 ServiceNow Customer & Industry Workflows Delivery Success Partner (CIWF), 2023 ServiceNow Worldwide Customer Workflow Partner of the Year, and 2023 ServiceNow Creator Workflow Partner of the Year.

We are #GoingBeyond. Come join our Crew.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Business Process Consultant – Telecom with deep experience in ServiceNow and the telecommunications industry to help clients modernize and optimize business operations across customer, service, and network workflows.

This is a process-first consulting role, ideal for someone who understands how telecom organizations operate across service management, network inventory, fulfillment, assurance, field operations, and customer support—and can translate that knowledge into scalable process designs enabled by ServiceNow.

You will work closely with client stakeholders to assess current-state operations, define future-state business processes, and guide transformation initiatives across capabilities such as TSOM, TNI, TSM, ITSM, FSM, and related telecom workflows. You will serve as a trusted advisor who can connect business goals, process maturity, operational efficiency, and platform value realization.

What You’ll Do

Business Process Advisory & Transformation

  • Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews to understand telecom operating models, pain points, and transformation opportunities
  • Analyze and redesign end-to-end business processes across service operations, network inventory, incident and case management, fulfillment, field service, and customer support
  • Define current-state and future-state process flows, business requirements, operating model changes, and value roadmaps
  • Advise clients on how to align business processes with ServiceNow telecom capabilities including TSOM, TNI, TSM, ITSM, and FSM
  • Help clients standardize and optimize workflows across OSS/BSS, network operations, customer operations, and enterprise service functions

Telecom Domain Leadership

  • Bring strong telecom process expertise across areas such as:
    • Telecom Service Operations Management (TSOM)
    • Telecom Network Inventory (TNI)
    • Telecommunications Service Management (TSM)
    • Incident, problem, and change management
    • Service fulfillment and assurance
    • Network and service inventory lifecycle management
    • Field operations and dispatch workflows
    • Procurement and asset-related operational processes
  • Guide clients on telecom-aligned process frameworks and integration patterns, including concepts related to TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open APIs, and OSS/BSS ecosystem alignment
  • Support business alignment between technical teams and operational stakeholders to ensure process decisions reflect real-world telecom delivery models

Client Engagement & Solution Shaping

  • Facilitate executive and working sessions to align stakeholders on priorities, business outcomes, governance, and transformation scope
  • Partner with solution architects, technical consultants, delivery leaders, and client teams to ensure process designs are practical, scalable, and measurable
  • Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, epics, KPI definitions, and transformation roadmaps
  • Support pre-sales and solutioning conversations by helping shape business-led telecom transformation strategies for prospective clients
  • Contribute to thought leadership and internal capability development in telecom process consulting and ServiceNow-enabled transformation

Value Realization & Continuous Improvement

  • Define success metrics and operational KPIs tied to efficiency, service quality, visibility, risk reduction, and cost optimization
  • Recommend governance structures, process controls, and adoption strategies to help clients sustain long-term value
  • Identify opportunities to improve process maturity, increase automation, and enhance user and customer experiences
  • Help clients prioritize initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes and accelerate time to value

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in telecom business process consulting, transformation, or operational design
  • Deep understanding of telecom workflows and operating models, especially across TSOM, TNI, TSM, ITSM, FSM, and related service operations
  • Experience working with ServiceNow in a consulting or client-facing capacity, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to business process outcomes
  • Proven ability to lead process discovery workshops, requirements gathering sessions, and future-state design discussions with business and operational stakeholders
  • Experience mapping and optimizing end-to-end processes across telecom domains such as:
    • network/service inventory
    • service assurance
    • service fulfillment
    • field service operations
    • customer support
    • cross-functional operational workflows
  • Familiarity with telecom standards and frameworks such as TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open APIs, and broader OSS/BSS integration environments
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and service management process design
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders ranging from operational managers to executive sponsors
  • Strong business documentation skills including process maps, requirements, roadmaps, business cases, and operating model recommendations
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, collaborative, and fast-moving consulting environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ServiceNow telecom solutions including TSOM, TNI, TSM, and adjacent workflows across ITSM, FSM, CSM, or ITOM
  • Familiarity with CSDM and enterprise service data concepts as they relate to telecom operations
  • Experience supporting OSS/BSS modernization or telecom digital transformation initiatives
  • Knowledge of service and resource inventory models, order orchestration concepts, and operational handoffs across network, service, and customer domains
  • Experience defining KPIs, governance models, and adoption strategies for enterprise transformation programs
  • Lean, Six Sigma, business process improvement, or business architecture experience is a plus
  • Experience in a consulting or professional services environment strongly preferred

Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Telecommunications, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
  • 8–12 years of experience in telecom operations, business process consulting, transformation, or ServiceNow-related advisory work
  • ServiceNow certifications are valued, but this role prioritizes business process expertise and telecom domain knowledge over deep platform engineering credentials
  • ITIL certification preferred
  • TM Forum or business process improvement certifications are a plus

Why NewRocket

At NewRocket, we help organizations go beyond workflows to solve meaningful business problems. You’ll join a team that values curiosity, collaboration, integrity, innovation, and empathy—because we believe the best outcomes happen when people matter.

In this role, you will:

  • Help shape the future of telecom business transformation at a leading AI-first ServiceNow partner
  • Partner with major organizations on high-impact initiatives that improve visibility, efficiency, and customer outcomes
  • Work alongside strategists, consultants, architects, designers, and engineers in a collaborative environment
  • Enjoy a flexible, remote-first culture that supports growth, balance, and continuous learning

We Take Care of Our People

We can’t create meaningful experiences without supporting our people. NewRocket offers:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Healthcare, dental, and vision
  • 401(k)
  • Paid time off
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Ongoing learning and certification support
  • A culture built on collaboration, innovation, and professional growth

NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact hr.us@newrocket.com.

raw.description:
WHAT WE DO

Founded in 2007, Growth Acceleration Partners (GAP) is a consulting and technology services company. We consult, design, build and modernize revenue-generating software and data engineering solutions for clients. With modernization services and AI tools, we help businesses achieve a competitive advantage through technology. GAP’s remote, integrated engineering teams use end-to-end solutions to innovate and align with your business goals. We have 600+ English-speaking engineers based in Latin America and approximately 20 U.S.-based engineers. With some of the highest customer satisfaction scores in the industry, GAP’s focus is customer and employee success.

GAP is a woman-owned company headquartered in Austin Texas. We are a values-based company focused on growing our people by investing in education, onsite English classes and training in the latest technologies, including AI, data analytics and machine learning. Our goal is to provide solutions for our customers that help them achieve critical business outcomes, while enabling our GAPSters and our communities to attain long-term success.

Summary

We are looking for an Advanced QA Automation Engineer to join our quality engineering team and contribute to an existing Playwright automation framework. In this role, you will be responsible for expanding test coverage, executing automated test suites, and leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to optimize quality assurance workflows. The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in core QA practices with hands-on contributions to test automation and an eagerness to apply generative AI tools to accelerate test creation, maintenance, and failure diagnostics.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Professional Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, spanning manual testing methodologies and test automation contributions

  • Hands-on experience working with modern web automation tools, specifically contributing to or executing scripts within a Playwright framework

  • Demonstrated experience utilizing generative AI or agentic tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to boost daily productivity, write test scripts, and debug code

  • Solid background in end-to-end test execution, bug reporting, and regression validation within Agile/Scrum environments

raw.title: People Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: About UsAt Sleep Doctor, we’re helping millions get a full night's rest.
raw.description:
About Us

At Sleep Doctor, we’re helping millions get a full night's rest. As the most trusted name in sleep health, we make better sleep possible with proven support, clear answers, and hands-on care that fits real life. Across our brands—SleepDoctor.com, SleepFoundation.org, and SleepApnea.org—we combine clinical expertise with consumer-first experiences to help people understand their sleep, tackle real challenges, and wake up to healthier, more energized lives. If you’re passionate about making better sleep possible—and want to help reshape the future of sleep care—we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

The People Operations Manager reports to the Senior Director of People. This is a remote position. Regular attendance at a company office is not required, although there might be travel as needed for business needs.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building scalable HR processes while serving as a trusted partner to leaders and employees. You'll help oversee day-to-day People Operations functions—including HR operations, employee relations, recruiting, performance management, compliance, compensation administration, and benefits—helping create an exceptional employee experience across a growing, multi-state organization.

What You'll Do

HR Operations

  • Manage all core HR operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employee records, HRIS administration, and PEO partnership.
  • Ensure HR processes are efficient, scalable, compliant, and employee-focused.
  • Maintain accurate employee data, reporting, and HR documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve systems and streamline workflows.

Employee Relations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on employee relations matters.
  • Coach managers through performance concerns, workplace issues, and difficult conversations.
  • Support investigations, documentation, corrective actions, and conflict resolution while ensuring consistency and fairness.

Performance Management

  • Administer the company's performance management program, including goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, and employee development.
  • Partner with managers to improve coaching, feedback, and accountability.
  • Track completion and ensure a consistent employee experience across the organization.

Recruiting & Onboarding

  • Manage recruiting operations from requisition through onboarding.
  • Partner with hiring managers to deliver an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Oversee interview scheduling, offers, background checks, onboarding, and new hire orientation.
  • Manage employee referral programs and recruiting processes.

Benefits Administration

  • Partner with brokers, benefit vendors, and our PEO to ensure smooth administration of employee benefits.
  • Support employees by answering benefit questions and resolving benefit-related issues.
  • Assist with annual open enrollment and ongoing benefit communications.

Compliance

  • Help maintain compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws while partnering with General Counsel on complex matters.
  • Update HR policies and procedures as regulations evolve.
  • Support audits and ensure HR documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.

Compensation & HR Programs

  • Administer annual compensation review and bonus processes.
  • Prepare HR reports, compensation analyses, and workforce metrics to support leadership decision-making.
  • Support ongoing People programs and initiatives that enhance employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources or People Operations experience.
  • Experience supporting organizations (or divisions) with 50+ employees in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Healthcare experience strongly preferred, particularly supporting a Physician Corporation (PC) and Management Services Organization (MSO) structure.
  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment laws.
  • Experience administering HRIS platforms (such as Gusto) and partnering with a PEO (such as Prestige).
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Passion for building a positive, high-performing company culture.
  • Excellent judgment, discretion, and ability to manage highly confidential information.
  • Outstanding communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to think strategically while also executing day-to-day operational work.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.
  • Experience supporting fully distributed, multi-state teams.
  • Experience working in high-growth startups or digital healthcare organizations.

Who We Are

  • We’re committed to a vision of millions waking rested and ready.
  • We are Human First because our patients and teammates are why we’re here.
  • We are growing rapidly but sustainably because we are committed to Relentless Progress.
  • Run into a challenge or a new opportunity? We tackle it as a team because we know that we are Stronger Together.
  • We’re going to push you to ask big questions and find bold answers. Everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of their title or job description

Compensation Range

$120,000 - $130,000. Note that final compensation is subject to the candidate’s specific qualifications and location, as well as the needs of the company. This position is eligible to participate in the company’s bonus program.

The Company currently provides medical, vision, and dental insurance and 100% of the employee medical, vision, and dental premiums covered by the Company. There is an option to participate in both a medical FSA and dependent care FSA. We offer a 401(k) plan, with fully matching contributions up to 3% of salary and 50% matching from 3% to 5% of salary. There is a company paid life-insurance policy, and the option to participate in a voluntary pet-insurance policy. You will be eligible for Paid Time Off in accordance with the company’s policies.

Sleep Doctor is committed to bringing together individuals from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and be their authentic self, feel a sense of community, and do great work together. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants.

Requisition ID

2026-4516

Job Summary

Business Lead

Artemis is seeking a full-time Business Lead to support the Veteran and Family Member Program at the Department of Veterans Affairs. This individual will be responsible for leading modernization efforts, connecting VFMP operational stakeholders with technical delivery teams. This role leads business requirements gathering, develops business rules that drive automation and efficiency across VFMP operations (intake, applications, claims, appeals, duty to assist, care coordination, benefits coordination, pharmacy, and nursing review), and provides project management support for the Data Integration Project delivering an integrated data layer for reporting and business rule decisions.

The Business Lead role requires a self-starter, proactive problem solver and action-oriented team player with previous experience in business analysis and project delivery for healthcare operations and modernization programs. This position needs an individual that is committed to providing superior service, poised under pressure and has a positive and flexible attitude.

This is a contingent hire position.

Offers will be contingent upon client approval, ability to meet security requirements, and the ability to adhere to any on-site requirements (which may change at contract award).

Remote work is anticipated. However, occasional travel for client engagements may be required.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between VFMP business stakeholders and delivery teams across intake, applications, claims, appeals, duty to assist, care coordination, benefits coordination, pharmacy, and nursing review operations.
  • Facilitate business requirement gathering and coordination sessions between stakeholders, publishing meeting notes no later than three business days after meetings and storing them in the project Document Repository.
  • Develop business rules and requirements for front-end data extraction from intake systems (mail, online, fax) and ingestion of extracted data into downstream systems of record to support automation.
  • Develop and implement business rules that reduce manual effort and drive efficiency and effectiveness across IVC business processes.
  • Lead development of Business/Workforce Optimization Plans and Recommendations, and support implementation of plans accepted by VFMP, including associated workforce efficiency tools.
  • Provide project management support for the Data Integration Project, including development of the Project Management Plan and coordination of a team of data engineers and analysts.
  • Translate business requirements into detailed functional requirements for technical teams, including Business Requirements Documents, process flows, and use cases/stories.
  • Monitor delivery within scope, schedule, and budget; identify risks and issues; and support Monthly Status Reports and quarterly progress reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4 years of experience managing projects or leading business delivery for a large corporation or government agency, preferably in a healthcare organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or similar in quality.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating stakeholder requirements sessions and developing business requirements, business rules, and process documentation.
  • Experience supporting data, automation, or systems modernization initiatives, preferably involving claims, eligibility, or healthcare operations.
  • Strategic thinker with a forward-looking approach to marketing trends and technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically.
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines.
  • Experience supporting complex projects and transformation efforts within the federal government.
  • Comfortability with supporting complex client relationships.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong critical thinking, analytical and time management skills.
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize and work well with others.
  • Ability to communicate thoughts, ideas and solutions logically both written and orally.
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to receive feedback from clients and implement changes quickly and effectively.
  • Ability to get up to speed quickly on complex issues.
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Reporting to the Creative Director, the Graphic Designer will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional in-house graphic services to the sales, marketing, and purchasing departments. Your responsibilities will span print and web design, encompassing product, packaging, signage, email, and website design.

Responsibilities

Without restricting the generality of the above-stated basic functions, this position shall perform such duties and responsibilities as may be assigned including but not restricted to the following:

Motion Graphics

  • Create motion graphics, animated assets, and visual effects for social media, digital advertising, and campaign content.
  • Develop animated text treatments, product callouts, transitions, and branded motion elements.

Video Editing

  • Edit short-form video content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
  • Produce content cutdowns, product videos, promotional videos, and platform-specific creative assets.
  • Optimize content for engagement and platform performance.

Email Marketing and Web

  • Create visually stunning email layouts that boost engagement, click-through rates, and sales growth when possible
  • Assist in expanding the company's brand identity
  • Conduct research on the latest design technologies and trends, and integrate them as needed
  • Develop email design templates, manipulate photo files, and design digital animations
  • Design multiple emails per week, ensuring timely and high-quality deployment

Exterior and Interior Store Design

  • Expertly design interior and exterior walls, windows, posters, and signage
  • Create eye-catching POP displays, such as counter and shelf displays, sidekicks, and side-stacks
  • Design impressive signage, including banners, easels, aisle talkers, and wobblers
  • Produce engaging animations and graphics for TV screens
  • Ensure all design deliverables align with branding guidelines

Retail Packaging

  • Generate innovative packaging concepts from competitor analysis, internal research, creative briefs, and manager directives.
  • Produce dielines for various packaging types, including boxes, wrappers, labels, stickers, and hangtags.
  • Ensure compliance with customer style-guides and prepare necessary approval documents.
  • Develop packaging dielines according to customer requirements and design specifications.

Product Design, Photography and Illustration

  • Design and format product instructions, catalogs, and brochures
  • Produce necessary technical and classical illustrations
  • Capture lifestyle photography as required

Organization

  • Collaborate effectively with fellow designers to achieve accurate and efficient work
  • Demonstrate superior multitasking abilities by managing multiple projects with strict adherence to deadlines and exceptional attention to detail
  • Exhibit excellent organizational skills by meticulously maintaining and properly labeling files on the art server

Production

  • Produce final files: outline, color swatch, and specification sheets
  • Thoroughly review final production for errors: file accuracy, color correctness, and dieline precision

Qualifications

  • 3-4 Year Bachelor or Diploma in Graphic Design
  • The candidate must have 2-5 years of graphic design experience with a strong portfolio showcasing expertise in print, multimedia, and animation.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and working on a MAC environment is essential.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office, experience using Klaviyo for email design, Shopify and Wordpress for web design, and basic tagging and programming is required.
  • The candidate should possess exceptional multitasking and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Strong verbal and written English skills are necessary to effectively communicate with clients and colleagues.
  • The candidate should have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to articulate design decisions clearly.

raw.description:
Account Manager (Full-Cycle Recruitment) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: LATAM Preferred
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring an Account Manager to own the full recruitment lifecycle for a portfolio of U.S.-based clients.

This is not a traditional account management role.

You’ll be responsible for managing hiring processes from kickoff through successful placement by partnering directly with clients, sourcing and evaluating top talent, coordinating interviews, negotiating offers, and ensuring a seamless experience for both clients and candidates.

If you enjoy building relationships, managing multiple searches, and delivering exceptional hiring outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Own the recruitment process from intake through successful placement.
  • Conduct kickoff meetings to understand hiring goals, role requirements, and ideal candidate profiles.
  • Develop sourcing strategies for each search.
  • Source candidates using:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Job boards
    • Internal talent pools
    • Professional networks
  • Screen resumes and conduct structured interviews.
  • Evaluate:
    • Skills
    • Experience
    • Communication
    • Cultural fit
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines across multiple open roles.

Candidate Management

  • Guide candidates through every stage of the hiring process.
  • Ensure every candidate completes a full application package before client submission, including:
    • Updated resume
    • Screening interview
    • Salary expectations
    • Availability and notice period
    • Introductory video
    • Required assessments (when applicable)
    • Additional client-requested documentation
  • Follow up proactively to ensure timely completion of hiring requirements.
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews.
  • Maintain consistent communication from first contact through onboarding.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
  • Provide regular hiring updates and market insights.
  • Present only fully qualified and thoroughly vetted candidates.
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and collect client feedback.
  • Manage offers, negotiations, onboarding, and successful placements.
  • Build long-term client relationships that encourage repeat business.

Recruitment Operations

  • Maintain accurate records in ATS and CRM systems.
  • Track candidate progress across every stage of the hiring process.
  • Keep hiring pipelines organized and up to date.
  • Meet hiring timelines while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Continuously improve recruitment workflows and candidate experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality candidates are presented quickly.
  • Hiring timelines are consistently met.
  • Clients receive proactive communication and exceptional service.
  • Candidates remain engaged throughout the hiring process.
  • Recruitment pipelines stay organized and accurate.
  • Placements lead to long-term client satisfaction and repeat business.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy owning the hiring process from beginning to end.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple searches simultaneously.
  • You’re an excellent interviewer with strong talent assessment skills.
  • You communicate clearly with both clients and candidates.
  • You’re proactive, responsive, and committed to delivering exceptional hiring experiences.
  • You build long-term relationships through trust, consistency, and results.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • Full-cycle recruitment
    • Talent acquisition
    • Agency recruiting
  • Experience managing multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
  • Strong experience sourcing, interviewing, and evaluating candidates.
  • Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interviewing and relationship-building abilities.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

Technical Skills

  • LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • CRM platforms
  • Google Workspace
  • Zoom

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for:
    • Technical roles
    • Sales
    • Operations
    • Executive leadership
  • Agency or staffing industry experience.
  • Experience recruiting remote global talent.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered recruiting and sourcing tools.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Meet with clients to discuss hiring priorities and open positions.
  • Source and screen candidates across multiple recruiting channels.
  • Conduct interviews and evaluate candidate fit.
  • Prepare complete candidate packages for client review.
  • Coordinate interviews and gather hiring feedback.
  • Update ATS and CRM records.
  • Manage offers, negotiations, and onboarding activities.
  • Provide hiring updates and market insights to clients.

In short: You’ll manage the entire recruitment lifecycle, helping clients hire exceptional talent while delivering an outstanding experience for every candidate.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Time to present qualified candidates.
  • Time to fill.
  • Number of successful placements.
  • Candidate response and engagement rates.
  • Application package completion rate.
  • Interview-to-offer ratio.
  • Offer acceptance rate.
  • Client satisfaction.
  • Candidate satisfaction.
  • Recruitment pipeline accuracy.

Why Join Pavago?

  • Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for a diverse portfolio of U.S. clients.
  • Build lasting relationships with both clients and candidates.
  • Work in a collaborative, fast-growing remote environment.
  • Gain exposure to hiring across multiple industries and functions.
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Senior Account Manager
    • Talent Acquisition Lead
    • Recruiting Manager
    • Client Success Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of an initial screening call, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your recruiting experience, and explain how you’ve managed full-cycle hiring, built candidate pipelines, partnered with clients, and successfully filled roles. You’ll also have the chance to highlight your approach to candidate experience, stakeholder communication, and recruitment operations. Your video will be reviewed by our recruitment team before moving forward to the interview stage.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about full-cycle recruiting, enjoy building strong client relationships, and thrive on helping companies hire exceptional talent, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key partner in delivering world-class hiring experiences.

Pay Plan Title:Care Manager

Working Title:RCT Regional Care Manager

FLSA Status:Non-Exempt

Posting Salary Range:$56,270 - $68,428

Office Location:Remote within 75 miles of Trillium’s Mid State Region (See requirements section for included counties)

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for an RCT Regional Care Manager to join our team! Trillium’s RCT Regional Care Manager plays a vital role in ensuring members receive

whole person-centered care to meet their individual and complex physical, mental health, and social

needs. The Care Manager serves as the single point of contact for members and works with a multidisciplinary care team, including primary care providers, specialists, care manager extenders, transition staff, and caretakers/legal guardians to promote continuity of care and quality care for each member.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Provide oversight and/or outreach, engagement, and support of members receiving Tailored Care Management.
  • Facilitate comprehensive assessments of members’ needs and evaluate results to determine the appropriateness and effectiveness of care.
  • Ensure the initiation and continuance of integrated care plans that incorporate a member’s physical health, mental health, social support, lifestyle, community involvement, and risks to well-being, among others.
  • Facilitate regular meetings with members, both face-to-face and telephonically.
  • Consult with providers to gather and share information relevant to each member’s care including care management comprehensive assessments, and reassessments.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)https://www.myncretirement.gov/systems-funds/local-governmental-employees-retirement-system-lgers/lgers-handbook
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet Qualified Professional (QP) status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with Long Term Services and Support (LTSS) needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or Home and Community Based Service (HCBS) coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within 75 miles of Trillium’s Mid State Region, which includes the following counties: Anson, Guilford, Montgomery, Randolph, and Richmond.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • License and/or certification may be accepted as noted above.

Deadline for Application:Thursday July 30, 2026, at 11:59PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.
