MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

We're looking for a People Operations Specialist to take full ownership of the provider (clinician) lifecycle: preboarding, onboarding, document coordination, and offboarding. You'll join the Business Operations team, working hand-in-hand with our Senior HR Ops Specialist on shared workflows, with close collaboration across Finance, Legal, and Clinical Operations.

Why this role

  • Real ownership from day one: you own the full provider lifecycle (preboarding → onboarding → offboarding) and your work directly determines whether providers have a smooth start and a clean exit.
  • Direct line to business impact: onboarding speed and quality directly affect how fast providers begin seeing patients and generating revenue; the importance of this function is recognized at C-level.
  • Shape the process, don't just run it: we're actively restructuring ownership of onboarding/offboarding, and we explicitly welcome spotting inefficiencies and building automation (Notion, Zapier) rather than following a fixed script.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end preboarding and onboarding for new providers: post-offer communication, document collection, checklist tracking, system setup coordination, Notion onboarding projects, welcome meetings, etc.
  • Manage provider offboarding workflows: documentation closure, system access removal, and coordination with Finance, Legal, and Clinical Operations.
  • Build and maintain HR operational reports on provider lifecycle metrics (time-to-onboard, completion rates, offboarding timelines, document status) to support decision-making by the Operations Manager.
  • Maintain referral bonus eligibility tracking for newly onboarded providers.
  • Maintain data accuracy and consistency across HR systems (BambooHR, Notion, Justworks, internal provider databases) throughout the employment lifecycle.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks in provider lifecycle workflows, support automation efforts, and document processes and SOPs as workflows evolve.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in HR operations, HR administration, or a generalist role with a strong operational focus.
  • Proven experience managing high-volume onboarding/offboarding cases in parallel, with reliable, on-time closure and zero dropped steps.
  • Experience with HRIS systems (BambooHR is a strong advantage) and disciplined data hygiene across multiple tools.
  • Solid Notion skills: task management, databases, and automation.
  • Strong analytical skills: building structured reports and dashboards, spotting patterns and anomalies in operational data.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented: accuracy in documents and checklists is non-negotiable in this role.
  • Strong cross-functional communication: comfortable flagging blockers early and building clear handoffs with Finance, Legal, and Clinical Operations.
  • Advanced English (C1+) written and spoken, for daily communication with US-based providers and stakeholders and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work 2 PM – 10 PM CET.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 3 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of security controls, threat models, and incident response capabilities specifically tailored to AI and machine learning systems. The role addresses the unique security challenges posed by LLMs, model APIs, training data pipelines, and AI-powered applications, including prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration, and supply chain risks. The ideal candidate has strong security engineering fundamentals and a deep understanding of how modern AI systems work in practice, with hands-on experience designing defenses for both AI-powered applications and the AI infrastructure that supports them.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and implement security controls specifically targeting LLM and AI-powered application risks.
  • Build threat models for AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and abuse patterns.
  • Design and deploy guardrails, content filters, and policy enforcement layers around model endpoints.
  • Implement runtime detection and response capabilities for adversarial prompts and abusive behavior.
  • Secure training and fine-tuning pipelines, including data provenance, integrity, and access controls.
  • Design controls for sensitive data handling, retention, and redaction in LLM workflows.
  • Lead red-team exercises against AI systems and drive remediation of identified weaknesses.
  • Evaluate and harden third-party AI services and open-source AI components used internally.
  • Implement identity, authorization, and tenant-isolation patterns for multi-tenant AI services.
  • Drive supply chain security for ML artifacts including weights, datasets, and inference dependencies.
  • Collaborate with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet regulatory obligations.
  • Develop monitoring, logging, and detection strategies tailored to AI workloads.
  • Lead incident response for AI-specific security events and drive durable improvements.
  • Stay current with adversarial ML, LLM security research, and emerging regulatory developments.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • Six or more years of security engineering experience, including significant work on AI or ML systems.
  • Strong understanding of LLM internals, modern AI architectures, and common failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience designing security controls for AI-powered applications.
  • Deep knowledge of application security, identity, and cryptography fundamentals.
  • Experience with threat modeling and security architecture review processes.
  • Familiarity with adversarial ML, prompt injection, and model abuse research.
  • Proficiency in Python and at least one systems language.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security and modern infrastructure controls.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Publications, talks, or CTF participation in AI security topics.
  • Experience with red-teaming LLM-based products.
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML techniques such as differential privacy.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict data handling requirements.
  • Open-source contributions to AI security tooling

Salesforce Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Salesforce Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Developer to design and build production-grade Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and integration platforms. The role is deeply hands-on, with responsibility for delivering custom business logic, integrations, user interfaces, and automation that meet complex enterprise requirements while respecting platform limits and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Salesforce work in production, writes idiomatic Apex and modern LWC, and balances declarative-first thinking with the willingness to write code where it provides clear value.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueable jobs, and scheduled jobs that respect governor limits and bulkification principles.
  • Build Lightning Web Components for rich, performant user experiences embedded across Salesforce surfaces.
  • Design and implement automation using Flow, Process Builder migration, and declarative-first patterns.
  • Develop integrations using REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Salesforce Connect.
  • Implement complex data models including custom objects, relationships, formula fields, and validation rules.
  • Build and maintain sharing models, profiles, permission sets, and row-level security configurations.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive Apex unit tests with meaningful coverage and assertions.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines using Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, or AutoRABIT.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to development standards, and document technical decisions.
  • Troubleshoot production issues including governor-limit errors, integration failures, and data anomalies.
  • Collaborate with admins, architects, and product owners to refine requirements.
  • Optimize performance for large-data-volume scenarios, including selective queries and async patterns.
  • Support upgrades, releases, and refactoring of legacy implementations toward modern patterns.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, Einstein/Agentforce features, and platform innovations.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Apex, SOQL, SOSL, and platform limits.
  • Strong proficiency in Lightning Web Components and modern JavaScript.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations using REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with Flow and declarative automation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model and sharing.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX and modern source-driven development.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
  • Experience with Industry Clouds (Financial Services, Health, Manufacturing).
  • Familiarity with MuleSoft or other middleware platforms.
  • Exposure to Einstein AI or Agentforce development.
  • Experience with Experience Cloud (Communities) development.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to hilda@bvteck.com. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.

We are looking for a seasoned sales executive who can bring their experience in Enterprise Sales allowing for effective engagement with key partners at several levels. You will build and execute the strategy to capture net new customers and deepen existing partnerships.

This position is responsible for developing growth strategies and driving revenue with our largest most strategic clients and partners. The position requires a track record of successful executive engagement in a complex solution selling and competitive environment. The position requires the ability to develop an account plan and to identify, sell and close large programs within these accounts. The candidate must have a consultative/strategic approach to selling solutions to sales, marketing, and procurement senior executives and C-level executives. You must have excellent presentation skills and relationship building is a must.

  • Skillfully manage a complex sales environments utilizing excellent negotiation, relationship and presentation skills.
  • Strong collaboration with internal stakeholders across BHN to achieve desired results.
  • Achieve strong customer satisfaction scores from clients.

raw.description:
Cardinal Health Sonexus™ Access and Patient Support helps specialty pharmaceutical manufacturers remove barriers to care so that patients can access, afford and remain on the therapy they need for a better quality of life. Our diverseexpertiseinpharma, payer and hub services allows us to deliver best-in-class solutions—driving brand and patient markers of success.We’recontinuously integrating advanced and emerging technologies to streamline patient onboarding,qualificationand adherence. Our non-commercial specialty pharmacy is centralized at our custom-designed facility outside of Dallas, Texas, empowering manufacturers to rethink the reach and impact of their products.

Together, we can get life-changing therapiestopatients who need them—faster.

What this position contributes to Cardinal Health

The Pharmacy Liaison Coordinator primarily serves as a liaison between the business, andSpecialtyPharmacystakeholder partners toensure hub patientssent to Specialty Pharmacies successfully access much needed therapy. This roleplays a critical rolein ensuring a seamless transition throughout the patient journey as the hub completesreimbursementservices andtransferthe patient to aSpecialtyPharmacyto complete theirjourney. Thisposition serves as a criticalbridge in ensuring patients get access to therapy in a fast,efficientand streamlined manner.

Responsibilities

  • Handle customer escalated cases through investigation and case review.

  • Responsible formaintainingan issues log that clearlystatesall encountered issues and steps to resolve the issue.

  • Mediate effective resolution for complex payer/pharmacy issues toward a positive outcome to de-escalate.

  • Answer requests from doctors and/or patientschecking onthe status of the triage.

  • Perform other activities related to internal initiatives and/or the manufacturer’s program as assigned.

  • Support manufacturer field team members asrequiredon case updates.

  • Works internally with team membersregardingpatients’ cases.

  • Ability toidentify, document, andsubmitAdverse Events during customer contact or via received documentation.

  • Serving as Single Point of Contact for Cardinal Health Sonexus™ Access and Patient Support related inquiries when communicating with specific and designated Specialty Pharmacies.

  • Responsible for handling escalated cases and reporting to field-based representatives as needed.

  • Responsible for running all reportsrelativeto Cardinal Health Sonexus™ Access and Patient Support and program dispenses, addressing any issues or errors discovered

  • Responsible for ensuring accounts are updated andaccurate,submittingIT escalations ifrequired.

  • Support the hub team with work overflow and reimbursement support when necessary.

  • Excellent observation skills to easilyidentifytrends and problems while providing solutions.
